## Checks run

1. S1 closed faithfully (Provenance, lines 66-78 at the new head):
   - §1 gains: "Ruling `6539345871` on #8345 (2026-10-31) amends D9's release gate (letter A′) and settles [Open item](#open-items) 2's `datetime` day (letter B); D9 and Open item 2 carry it as dated notes, and nothing else in [Decision](#decision) rests on it." Verified: the ruling comment is dated 2026-10-31T05:04Z; inside `## Decision` (lines 163-312) the only citation of 6539345871 is the D9 note (line 294); the other citations are TL;DR (line 60), Provenance (69), Open item 2 (386) and Open item 3's S2-wording sentence (415), none in Decision. "Carries only these two" is kept and now qualified in the next sentence, so the enumeration and the record agree.
   - §3 gains: "The dated notes of 2026-11-04 read `origin/main` at `f68b47ca` the same way." Matches the Evidence line (lines 36-37) and the merge base of the branch (f68b47ca).
2. S2 closed faithfully (Open item 2 note, lines 377-380): the quoted predicate now reads `where: { currency, effective_date: { $lte: onOrBefore } }`, `orderBy: [{ field: 'effective_date', order: 'desc' }]`, `limit: 1`. Compared character-for-character with packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#homeAmountServing on origin/main (9a53fc9f), lines 3576-3578: identical. The gloss "with `onOrBefore` the document day" matches the parameter's role (`rateOn(organizationId, currency, onOrBefore)` is called with `date` from `documentDateOf`). The rest of the sentence (system read in the row's own organization; one organization's rate never converts another's amount; `#homeAmountServing`) is unchanged.
3. Nothing else changed in meaning: `git diff 244f2ff0 a0c8d7ca` shows only the two hunks above; Open item 13, numbering 1–13, headings, D9 note, TL;DR note, Status block and all other dated notes are untouched. The 244f2ff0 record's findings carry.
4. Gates on a scratch worktree at a0c8d7ca (removed afterwards): `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` exit 0 (979 links resolve); `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` exit 0 (3108 anchors across 149 records resolve); `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` exit 0; `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --report` exit 0 (README current). Contract review · PR #30174 @ 244f2ff0 · CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER
Verdict: PASS

Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER
Head-sha: 244f2ff0593874d699d0fb7dc41db3e1850bf661 (one commit on origin/claude/project-thread-b5ine2; merge-base with origin/main = f68b47ca; origin/main at 9a53fc9f)
Scope: docs/adr/0144-multi-currency-record-currency-dated-rates-write-time-home-projection.md (1 file, +119/-3)
Card: #30102 (open). Sources read: PR #28302 body ("ADR-0144 open items settled here", "Hand-off points"), ruling 6539345871 (A′ and B), ruling 6522614678 (A), contract review 6539117549 and its delta 6539668963 on PR #28302, PR #28181's diff (form of earlier dated notes), card #30102 body. Every file#symbol below opened on origin/main (9a53fc9f); the only cited file that moved between f68b47ca and origin/main is packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, and that diff touches none of the home-amount symbols (grep on the diff for homeAmount|HomeLocalization|effective_date: 0 lines).

## Must-fix

None.

## Should-fix

- S1 — docs/adr/0144-…md:67-68 (Provenance §1, unchanged by this PR) still reads "Ruling `6465431966` fixes … Ruling `6469382727` on #27185 fixes parameter 4's unit. [Decision] carries only these two." After this PR, D9 (line 291) carries a third ruling, `6539345871`, by dated note. The note itself is correctly sourced and labelled "amended by ruling", so the Provenance rule (Decision carries only ruled text) holds in substance, but the enumeration is now stale. One clause in Provenance §1 naming `6539345871` as the amendment of D9's release gate would close it. Same class, lower weight: Provenance §3 says readings were "measured at `cdec7473`" while the Evidence line (line 36-37) now also names `f68b47ca` for the 2026-11-04 notes.
- S2 — docs/adr/0144-…md:375 (Open item 2 note) quotes the engine's predicate as `where: { currency, effective_date: { $lte: day } }`; the tree spells the bound `onOrBefore` (packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#homeAmountServing, `effective_date: { $lte: onOrBefore }`). The shape is the same and the sentence does not claim verbatim quotation, but a backticked predicate reads as a quote; `onOrBefore` or a prose "the document day" would remove the gap.

## Checks run

1. Card #30102 Task list against the diff:
   - Open items 2, 3, 4, 6, 9 each gain a `*Note (2026-11-04):* settled …` paragraph in the form PR #28181 used for items 11–13 (`*Note (2026-10-30):* settled: …` with PR + merge sha + file#symbol). Done.
   - Ruling 6539345871 A′ recorded in D9 (dated note, lines 291-309) and in TL;DR (lines 59-61, pointing at D9); B recorded in Open item 2 (lines 377-382) with "Not chosen: A". Both match the ruling's text (maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-31T05:03Z; VP #26517 waits for #28302 and #28297; R2 core = #27185/#27191/#27192/#27198; R2.1 = #27193/#27190/#27196; amendment of 6522614678 letter A in one respect with the ruling's reason; not chosen A/B/C; B = calendar day in `localization.timezone`, default UTC, never request zone, not chosen A). Done.
   - Rounding "once, half away from zero", rate stored unrounded: Open item 3 note. Done.
   - CLDR fraction digits, not ISO 4217 minor units: Open item 3 note ("with one correction to the sentence above"), Context §1 note (line 105-109), Consequences note (line 341-343). The original item-3 sentence (line 390) and the Context §1 "no reader" sentence are kept and corrected by note, the amendment form this record uses. Done.
   - "the only ledger additions" dropped: Status block now says "Three of them need new codes … all three are registered" with a dated note recording the old wording (lines 14-19). Done.
   - Open item 13: byte-identical between origin/main and head (diff of the item-13 block: IDENTICAL). Numbering 1–13 intact; headings unchanged. Done.
2. Every landed-code claim opened at file#symbol on origin/main:
   - packages/objectql/src/home-amount-projection.ts: `projectHomeAmounts` (same-currency arm stores rate `1` and rounds; blank date throws ValidationError `required` on the rateDate field; `rate.digits <= 0n` counts as missing; rate stored as the row holds it), `memoizeHomeAmountServing` (per organization/currency/day), `documentDateOf` + `calendarDayIn` (Intl en-CA in the org zone; UTC when absent/unknown), `toScaledDecimal`, `divideToPlaces`, `divideRoundHalfAwayFromZero` (half away from zero; checked 1.005→1.01, −0.125→−0.13 by hand against the code), `ExchangeRateMissingError` (message names currency, date, home currency, "Setup → Exchange Rates", "never replaced by 1, by a later rate, or by an empty home amount"; status 400), `HomeCurrencyUnsetError` (unset or non-ISO code; status 400), `settleBulkHomeAmounts` (`invalid_value`, "update those rows by id"). All exist and say what the notes say.
   - packages/objectql/src/engine.ts#homeAmountServing (lines 3557-3590): `where: { currency, effective_date: { $lte: onOrBefore } }`, `orderBy effective_date desc`, `limit: 1`, context `{ ...context, isSystem: true, tenantId: organizationId }`; docblock says one organization's rate never converts another's. `#setHomeLocalizationResolver` (line 3535) exists (body delegated to engine-references-and-master-detail.ts by the #29986 codemod; the method remains in engine.ts).
   - packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts lines 1334-1376: `getMany('localization', ['currency','timezone'])` grouped read; no settings service / `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE` / `SETTINGS_UNKNOWN_KEY` read as unset; other errors propagate. Matches item 4 note.
   - packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts#ERROR_CODE_LEDGER, `'@objectstack/objectql'` block (lines 777-825): `ERR_CURRENCY_CODE_REQUIRED`, `ERR_EXCHANGE_RATE_MISSING`, `ERR_HOME_CURRENCY_UNSET` all present.
   - packages/spec/src/data/index.ts:204 `export * from './currency-fraction-digits'`.
   - packages/spec/src/data/currency-fraction-digits.ts: header says CLDR 48.0 `currencyData` snapshot; table has IQD 0, HUF 0, COP 0, IDR 0, PKR 0, JPY 0, USD 2, CNY 2, KWD 3.
   - packages/spec/src/data/numeric-column-representation.ts#numericColumnFor exists; file documents the one `decimal(65, 30)` column.
   - packages/services/service-settings/src/localization-currency-lock.ts#localizationCurrencyWritePredicate: `if (isUnset(current)) return undefined;` then refuses when any rate row or `homeAmount` declaration exists — "passes the first setting of an unset value" is what the code does and what its header says.
   - packages/objectql/src/validation/record-currency-code.ts#RecordCurrencyCodeRequiredError: `field` names the code field (docblock lines 32-34).
   - packages/objectql/src/engine-references-and-master-detail.ts#previewHomeAmounts (line 118) and packages/objectql/src/engine-validate.ts (lines 573, 606-608): a home-amount refusal is answered as the row's finding `{ field, code, message }` with the same code.
   - No registration-time check of `localization.currency` against a `homeAmount` declaration exists on main (grep of spec field.zod.ts/object.zod.ts and objectql for HOME_CURRENCY_UNSET: only the projection, engine and tests), so "the refusal is at write, not at registration" is a reading of the tree, consistent with ruling 6539345871 rejecting option C.
3. Every ruling/review claim against its source:
   - Ruling 6539345871: A′ and B text, maintainer 「同意」, the S2 wording order before #28302 merged, not-chosen lists — all as recorded.
   - Ruling 6522614678 (2026-10-30T12:16Z, letter A): "R2 development starts now; only the R2 release waits for the customer's consolidation terms" — the D9 note's paraphrase is accurate; Context §2 line 134-135 quotes the three terms.
   - Review 6539117549: ③.1 (D5 rejected fallbacks, D8 rule 5, distinct code because the remedy differs, "only ledger additions" owed), ③.3 (rateField scale < 12 escalated as domain:spec), F1 (CLDR vs ISO 4217, ~17 codes: IQD + 16 zero-digit codes), F4 (half away from zero = accounting HALF_UP), S2, S4 — all as cited. Delta 6539668963 exists on PR #28302 and widens S4 to exactly this PR's content.
   - PR #28302 body "ADR-0144 open items settled here" and "Hand-off points": items 2/3/4/6/9 notes match; "rate stored unrounded", "scale below 12 … spec-lane", `1.005`, 71994.24 all from the body.
4. Landing evidence for the D9 note (GitHub API): #26517 merged 2026-11-03T14:44Z at 83d7e4ae; #27246 194e66c0; #28096 73b72709; #28297 291bf44a; #28302 6762dd91; #27339 57c51aab (Fixes #27186). `## 18.3.0` sections of packages/objectql, packages/spec, packages/platform-objects, packages/services/service-settings CHANGELOG.md each name the cited entry; content/docs/releases/v18/18-3.mdx lines 811, 932, 933, 950 name them.
5. Nothing ruled that no ruling or landed code settled: every "settled" sentence is traced to ruling 6539345871, review 6539117549/6539668963, or a symbol on main; open questions (rateField scale < 12; PR #28128 S1 on item 13) are left explicitly undecided.
6. Residual phrasings: grep of the head file for "ISO 4217 minor|minor unit|only ledger" hits only the dated notes that correct them and the preserved original item-3 sentence they correct. Anchors `#open-items`, `#decision` resolve (heading `## Open items` at line 348).
7. Gates run locally on a scratch worktree at 244f2ff0 (no node_modules; scripts are plain node): `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` exit 0 (979 links resolve); `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` exit 0 (3108 anchors across 149 records resolve); `node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` exit 0; `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --report` exit 0 (README current). Head-pinned CI check-runs were not read in this record (docs-only PR; the seat's ACCEPT step pins them).
8. Scope: one file under docs/adr/**, no code, no changeset (docs-only, `skip-changeset` declared in the PR body), no content/docs/releases/ change. PR body first line cites the card; `Fixes #30102` is correct since the card's whole Task list is covered (item 13 branch: "otherwise leave item 13 as it is" — the seat reports S1 unruled, and item 13 is untouched).
